Upon receipt, I will:

- Extract presenting complaint, onset, duration, progression
- Document past medical history, allergies, medications
- Note relevant physical findings
- State clinical impression/working diagnoses
- Outline management plan, including follow-up
- Integrate the DDx only if consistent with the transcript, with brief likelihood tags
- Provide all sections in the exact structure below
